description: This file defines classes, structs, and functions related to CUDA memory allocation and caching in the PyTorch c10 library, including the CUDACachingAllocator and related utilities.

classes.name: FreeMemoryCallback
classes.description: Abstract class for callbacks to free CUDA memory, with a virtual Execute method.

classes.name: SegmentInfo
classes.description: Contains information about a CUDA memory segment, including device, size, stream, and blocks.

classes.name: BlockInfo
classes.description: Contains information about a memory block within a segment, including size, request size, and context.

classes.name: AllocatorState
classes.description: Abstract base class for representing the state of a CUDA allocator.

classes.name: TraceEntry
classes.description: Represents a trace event related to CUDA memory operations, including action type, device, address, size, stream, and metadata.

classes.name: AnnotationEntry
classes.description: Stores annotations for CUDA memory operations, including device, timestamp, and user metadata.

classes.name: AllocatorConfigInfo
classes.description: Configuration parameters for the CUDA allocator, such as thresholds and segment sizes.

classes.name: SnapshotInfo
classes.description: Contains snapshot data of CUDA segments, traces, annotations, and configuration.

classes.name: CheckpointDelta
classes.description: Holds pointers that were freed and allocated during a checkpoint operation.

classes.name: ShareableHandle
classes.description: Represents an IPC handle for sharing CUDA memory between processes.

classes.name: StreamSegmentSize
classes.description: Describes the size of a CUDA stream segment, including stream, size category, and total size.

classes.name: CUDAAllocator
classes.description: Abstract class defining the interface for CUDA memory allocators, including methods for allocation, deallocation, snapshotting, and configuration.

methods.name: raw_alloc
methods.description: Allocates raw device memory of specified size.

methods.name: raw_alloc_with_stream
methods.description: Allocates device memory with an associated CUDA stream.

methods.name: raw_delete
methods.description: Deletes previously allocated device memory.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the CUDA allocator for a given number of devices.

methods.name: getMemoryFraction
methods.description: Returns the fraction of total memory to be used for allocation.

methods.name: setMemoryFraction
methods.description: Sets the fraction of total memory to be used for allocation.

methods.name: getExpandableSegmentSizes
methods.description: Returns sizes of expandable memory segments for a device.

methods.name: enable
methods.description: Enables or disables the CUDA allocator.

methods.name: isEnabled
methods.description: Checks if the CUDA allocator is enabled.

methods.name: cacheInfo
methods.description: Provides information about the largest free block in the cache.

methods.name: getBaseAllocation
methods.description: Returns the base allocation and size for a given pointer.

methods.name: snapshot
methods.description: Creates a snapshot of the current allocator state.

methods.name: beginAllocateToPool
methods.description: Starts allocation of memory to a specific pool with a filter.

methods.name: endAllocateToPool
methods.description: Ends allocation to a specific pool.

methods.name: releasePool
methods.description: Releases a memory pool.

methods.name: checkPoolLiveAllocations
methods.description: Checks if the pool's live allocations match expected set.

methods.name: shareIpcHandle
methods.description: Creates an IPC handle for sharing memory.

methods.name: getIpcDevPtr
methods.description: Returns a device pointer from an IPC handle.

methods.name: name
methods.description: Returns the name of the allocator.

methods.name: memcpyAsync
methods.description: Performs an asynchronous memory copy, possibly using peer-to-peer.

methods.name: enablePeerAccess
methods.description: Enables peer access between devices.

methods.name: setUserMetadata
methods.description: Sets user metadata for the allocator.

methods.name: getUserMetadata
methods.description: Retrieves user metadata.
